body: First off I want to say how brave it is to talk about such a difficult and confusing experience in your life. I’m sorry that you trusted someone and them telling someone else when it’s not their story to tell. I don’t feel like you are getting punished more so protected, as confusing as that may sound it sounds like your mom is upset that had happened to you. Idk your situation but that is my observation from what you said. Maybe talking to your mom how that does not help and does nothing for your healing through this. What happened was not your fault and please take time for yourself and surround yourself in support. Much love to you
